$comment: Palette derived from the client's own primary wordmark (RVS Logo - Riverview_Primary_FullColor.png, pulled from riverview-square.com and committed at public/brand/riverview-square-wordmark.png). `river` and `signal` are sampled directly from that file: #003B2D is the RIVERVIEW half, #52CECB the SQUARE half — they are the two colours the mark is actually built from, not an interpretation of them. `ink`, `paper`, `limestone` and `brick` are still chosen rather than sampled: they are the neutrals and the masonry accent the mark does not specify, picked to sit with the sampled pair (ink and paper both carry a green cast so the greys read as the same family) and to clear the WCAG AA gate in brand/tokens.test.ts. This is no longer a wholly provisional palette — see TOKENS-PENDING.md for what remains unconfirmed.
